lines: [calm, professional] Site Seven. Beacon's last signal: room six, east end. [matter-of-fact] In and out.
[measured] Reyes, first assignment. [a touch of warmth] Stay on Vance's six.
[gruff, focused] Relay's up. [casual] You seeing us, Dispatch?
[calm] I've got you. Reconstruction's holding.
[quietly, nervous] Is it always this quiet?
[dry, low chuckle] Quiet's good. [serious] Don't count the doors, kid.
[sharp, hushed] Hold. [tense] Nobody moves.
[firm] Don't engage. Beacon first.
[low, steady] Slow. East end.
[uneasy, under breath] This one's ice cold. [strained] Won't turn.
[quiet, firm] Leave it.
[whispers] It's just... [shaky breath] standing there.
[whispering, urgent] Don't look at it. Keep walking.
[relieved] Got it. [confused] It's registered to... RT-04?
[heavy, quiet] Team 04.
[low] That's Holloway's.
[neutral, procedural] Confirm recovery, Vance.
[hesitant] ...Confirmed.
[calm but urgent] Site Seven closes on a cycle. [deliberate] One minute fifty. [firm] Every door to the outside has to be shut when it does.
[tense, whispering] It's between us and the exit.
[breathing hard, grim] Rounds don't stop it. They just buy seconds.
[thinking aloud, unsure] Two doors opened on their own. [realizing] Both times, it got closer.
[grim] And that one's next.
[straining] Won't open. [tense] It's got this one.
[determined] Then we don't let it open.
[decisive] I hold four. Lose four, it takes another door.
[commanding, fast] Leave it nothing. Oda, the exit. Reyes, room three.
[scared] Three's where it started.
[firm, raised voice] Not anymore. Go.
[urgent, steady] Reyes. Don't stop.
[straining, breathless] When I let go, it opens. Be ready.
[tense] On you.
[shouting, panicked] Pack's clear! Shut it, hold it!
[steady, urgent] Hold it. Seventeen seconds.
[breathing hard] ...Is it over?
[exhausted, quiet] For tonight.
[flat, procedural] Beacon's logged. Stabilizer's authorized for all three of you.
[tired, pointed] That beacon was Holloway's. [pressing] Why does the report say unregistered?
[evasive] ...Get some sleep, Vance.
